12020-a-woman-of-the-world-her-counsel-t.title: Her Counsel To Other People'S Sons And Daughters
12020-a-woman-of-the-world-her-counsel-t.creator: Ella Wheeler Wilcox
12020-a-woman-of-the-world-her-counsel-t.description: A book by Ella Wheeler Wilcox. Were you an older man, my dear Ray, your letter would be consigned to the flames unanswered, and our friendship would become constrained and formal, if it did not end utterly. But knowing you to be so many years my junior, and so slightly acquainted with yourself or womankind, I am going to be the friend you need, instead of the misfortune you invite.

arxiv-1701-02490.title: Real-Time Bidding by Reinforcement Learning in Display Advertising Conference: WSDM 2017, February 06-10, 2017, Cambridge, United Kingdom
arxiv-1701-02490.creator: † Han Cai, † Kan Ren, † Weinan Zhang, ‡ Kleanthis Malialis, ‡♮ Jun Wang, † Yong Yu, ♯ Defeng Guo
arxiv-1701-02490.description: Abstract The majority of online display ads are served through real-time bidding (RTB) — each ad display impression is auctioned off in real-time when it is just being generated from a user visit. To place an ad automatically and optimally, it is critical for advertisers to devise a learning algorithm to cleverly bid an ad impression in real-time.

arxiv-2105-03906.title: TextAdaIN: Paying Attention to Shortcut Learning in Text Recognizers
arxiv-2105-03906.creator: Oren Nuriel, Sharon Fogel, Ron Litman
arxiv-2105-03906.description: Abstract Leveraging the characteristics of convolutional layers, neural networks are extremely effective for pattern recognition tasks. However in some cases, their decisions are based on unintended information leading to high performance on standard benchmarks but also to a lack of generalization to challenging testing conditions and unintuitive failures.

arxiv-2111-11487.title: A Comparison of State-of-the-Art Techniques for Generating Adversarial Malware Binaries
arxiv-2111-11487.creator: Prithviraj Dasgupta, Zachariah Osman
arxiv-2111-11487.description: Abstract Abstract We consider the problem of generating adversarial malware by a cyber-attacker where the attacker’s task is to strategically modify certain bytes within existing binary malware files, so that the modified files are able to evade a malware detector such as machine learning-based malware classifier.

arxiv-2111-13311.title: Blaschke Product Neural Network (BPNN): A Physics-Infused Neural Network for Phase Retrieval of Meromorphic Functions
arxiv-2111-13311.creator: Juncheng Dong, Simiao Ren, Yang Deng
arxiv-2111-13311.description: Abstract Numerous physical systems are described by ordinary or partial differential equations whose solutions are given by holomorphic or meromorphic functions in the complex domain. In many cases, only the magnitude of these functions are observed on various points on the purely imaginary j ​ ω j\omega -axis since coherent measurement of their phases is often expensive.

arxiv-2201-07808.title: Boosted tau lepton as a microscope and macroscope
arxiv-2201-07808.creator: Sitian Qian, Zhe Guan, Sen Deng, Yunxuan Song, Tianyu Mu, Jie Xiao, Tianyi Yang, Siguang Wang, Yajun Mao, Qiang Li, Meng Lu, Zhengyun You
arxiv-2201-07808.description: Abstract Anomalies from the LHCb lepton flavour universality and Fermilab muon anomalous magnetic moment, show tantalizing hints of possible new physics from the lepton sectors. Due to its large mass and shorter lifetime than muon, the tau lepton is believed to couple more to possible new physics beyond the Standard Model.

arxiv-2211-14788.title: Plausible Adversarial Attacks on Direct Parameter Inference Models in Astrophysics
arxiv-2211-14788.creator: Benjamin Horowitz, Peter Melchior
arxiv-2211-14788.description: Abstract In this work we explore the possibility of introducing biases in physical parameter inference models from adversarial-type attacks. In particular, we inject small amplitude systematics into an mixture density networks tasked with inferring cosmological parameters from observed data. The systematics are constructed analogously to white-box adversarial attacks.

arxiv-2212-03040.title: Mixing in two-dimensional shear flow with smooth fluctuations
arxiv-2212-03040.creator: Nikolay A. Ivchenko, Vladimir V. Lebedev, Sergey S. Vergeles
arxiv-2212-03040.description: Abstract Chaotic variations in flow speed up mixing of scalar fields via intensified stirring. This paper addresses the statistical properties of a passive scalar field mixing in a regular shear flow with random fluctuations against its background. We consider two-dimensional flow with shear component dominating over smooth fluctuations. Such flow is supposed to model passive scalar mixing e.g.

arxiv-2401-06052.title: Fast High Dynamic Range Radiance Fields for Dynamic Scenes
arxiv-2401-06052.creator: Guanjun Wu, Taoran Yi, Jiemin Fang, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang
arxiv-2401-06052.description: Abstract Neural Radiances Fields (NeRF) and their extensions have shown great success in representing 3D scenes and synthesizing novel-view images. However, most NeRF methods take in low-dynamic-range (LDR) images, which may lose details, especially with nonuniform illumination. Some previous NeRF methods attempt to introduce high-dynamic-range (HDR) techniques but mainly target static scenes.

arxiv-2510-05065.title: Quasi-integrability from 𝒫𝒯 {\cal PT} -symmetry
arxiv-2510-05065.creator: Kumar Abhinav, Partha Guha, Indranil Mukherjee
arxiv-2510-05065.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kumar Abhinav, Partha Guha, Indranil Mukherjee. Parity and time-reversal ( 𝒫𝒯 {\cal PT} ) symmetry is shown as the natural cause of quasi-integrability of deformed integrable models. The condition for asymptotic conservation of quasi-conserved charges appear as a direct consequence of the 𝒫𝒯 {\cal PT} -symmetric phase of the system, ensuring definite 𝒫𝒯 {\cal PT} -properties of the corresponding Lax pair as well as that of the anomalous contribution. This construction applies to quasi-deformations of multiple systems such as KdV, NLSE and non-local NLSE.

arxiv-2602-02413.creator: Rajalaxmi Rajagopalan*, Ritwik Giri, Zhiqiang Tang, Kyu Han, Gerald Friedland
arxiv-2602-02413.description: Abstract Supervised speech enhancement methods have been very successful. However, in practical scenarios, there is a lack of clean speech, and self-supervised learning-based (SSL) speech enhancement methods that offer comparable enhancement performance and can be applied to other speech-related downstream applications are desired.

These materials have demonstrated enhanced performance when compared to SACs. The choice of metal precursors plays an important role in the synthesis of DACs.

pmc-11436561.title: Multiomic biomarkers after cardiac arrest
pmc-11436561.creator: Victoria Stopa, Gabriele Lileikyte, Anahita Bakochi, Prasoon Agarwal, Rasmus Beske, Pascal Stammet, Christian Hassager, Filip Årman, Niklas Nielsen, Yvan Devaux
pmc-11436561.description: Cardiac arrest is a sudden cessation of heart function, leading to an abrupt loss of blood flow and oxygen to vital organs. This life-threatening emergency requires immediate medical intervention and can lead to severe neurological injury or death. Methods and biomarkers to predict neurological outcome are available but lack accuracy. Such methods would allow personalizing healthcare and help clinical decisions.

pmc-11640009.creator: Blaž Barun, Zdravko Divić, Dušanka Martinović Kaliterna, Ana Poljičanin, Benjamin Benzon, Jure Aljinović, Maciej Płaszewski
pmc-11640009.description: Objective: Can mobile app intervention via push notifications increase adherence to exercise and reduce disability and pain after a whiplash injury? Methods: A randomized controlled trial was conducted with concealed allocation, blinding of some assessors, and an intention-to-treat analysis. Participants who sustained whiplash injury at most 3 months prior were divided into active and control groups.

pmc-12418944.title: Multiple environmental stressors mediate cyanobacteria recruitment in microcosms simulating spring conditions from two Midwest US hypereutrophic reservoirs
pmc-12418944.creator: Maggie Voyles, Lesley B Knoll
pmc-12418944.description: Cyanobacteria harmful algal blooms (cyanoHABs) are a complex threat to water quality. Most research to date on the drivers of cyanoHABs focuses on environmental factors in the typical “growing season” despite evidence that cyanobacteria overwintering dynamics may have substantial effects on cyanobacteria seasonal succession and bloom formation.

pmc-12435488.title: Mechanism of Ferroptosis and Its Role in Disease Development
pmc-12435488.creator: Zhangruijian Ye, Bin Xie, Yongguang Tao, Desheng Xiao
pmc-12435488.description: Ferroptosis is a type of cell death that differs from general forms of cell death such as apoptosis. Iron accumulation and lipid peroxidation are distinct biochemical features of ferroptosis. Accumulation of iron ions in ferrodead cells can increase the probability of the Fenton reaction and produce more reactive oxygen species (ROS). Further, iron ions are cofactors for some intracellular oxidases.

pmc-12461979.title: Temporal trends and machine learning prediction of depressive symptoms among Chinese middle-aged and elderly individuals: a national cohort study
pmc-12461979.creator: Qing Huang, Zihao Jiang, Mei Han
pmc-12461979.description: BackgroundThe prevalence of depression symptoms, the third most disabling disease worldwide, is as high as 11.5%-21.1% in China’s middle-aged and elderly population and increases significantly with age. It is crucial to identify high-risk groups efficiently and implement appropriate early interventions to improve the performance of depression risk prediction models.

pmc-12706577.title: Determinants of balance impairment in individuals with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease: A secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
pmc-12706577.creator: Hassan Alrabbaie, Marla Beauchamp, Cindy Ellerton, Roger Goldstein, Annemarie L Lee, Jennifer A Alison, Gail Dechman, Kimberley J Haines, Samantha L Harrison, Anne E Holland, Alda Marques, Lissa Spencer, Michael K Stickland, Elizabeth H Skinner, Dina Brooks
pmc-12706577.description: BackgroundBalance impairment is common in individuals with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), increasing fall risk and reducing functional independence. This study investigated functional, clinical, and demographic determinants of balance performance in individuals with COPD.MethodsThis secondary analysis included participants from a randomized controlled trial involving pulmonary rehabilitation centers.

pmc-12723385.title: Beyond locomotion: How specialized motor patterns enable a vertebrate to struggle free from capture
pmc-12723385.creator: Saeed Farjami, Andrey Palyanov, Hong-Yan Zhang, Valentina Saccomanno, Robert Merrison-Hort, Andrea Ferrario, Roman Borisyuk, Joel Tabak, Wen-Chang Li
pmc-12723385.description: SummaryAnimals captured by predators can still survive the attack by struggling to release themselves. We investigated how Xenopus tadpoles use struggling movements to free themselves from head restraint. High-speed video tracking revealed a stereotyped sequence of body flexions with distinct kinematics during capture and release.

pmc-12735399.title: Road Traffic Accidents in the Northern Border Region of Saudi Arabia: A Retrospective Cross-Sectional Study Using Secondary Data
pmc-12735399.creator: Fatima Alnoor, Ebtesam Babeker, Ehssan Ahmed, Alaa Mustafa
pmc-12735399.description: Background:Road traffic accidents (RTAs) are a global public health concern and a major concern in developing countries such as Saudi Arabia.Objective:To describe the characteristics, patterns, and contributing factors of RTAs in the Northern Border area of Saudi Arabia for the time period from 2016 to 2018.

pmc-12752370.title: Kisspeptin mediates the impact of chronic psychological stress on reproductive and metabolic dysregulation in polycystic ovary syndrome: evidence from human and rat models
pmc-12752370.creator: Tingting Mo, Yue Qiu, Shuangshuang He, Guibin Wang, Bingbing Li, Qian Shen, Xiaowei Nie, Jiali Wei, Nachuan Li, Bo Pang, Yanfeng Liu, Xue Pan
pmc-12752370.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and mental health disorders have high rates of co-occurrence. Although the precise pathophysiological mechanisms remain unknown, the observed changes in those conditions may be modulated by kisspeptin (Kiss1), a protein that regulates energy metabolism.

pmc-13099348.title: An optimized translating ribosome affinity purification protocol for low-abundance Drosophila tissues
pmc-13099348.creator: Leonor Miller-Fleming, Wing Hei Au, Alexander J Whitworth
pmc-13099348.description: SummaryLocalized protein translation enables spatially restricted cellular dynamics, particularly in neurons, where specific mRNAs are translated in axons and dendrites far from the cell body. Translating ribosome affinity purification (TRAP) has been used to study axonal translation in rodents and cell-type-specific translation in Drosophila, but existing protocols are not optimized for axons, where material is extremely limited.

pmc-13427231.title: In Situ Programmable Modulation of Hydrogel Stiffness for Stage‐Adaptive Bone Regeneration
pmc-13427231.creator: Yuxin Yang, Fan Yang, Lu Wang, Zongtai Li, Weichang Li, Xinchun Zhang
pmc-13427231.description: Bone defect healing is a dynamic process involving changes in the mechanical properties of the extracellular matrix (ECM), which significantly influence cellular behavior and tissue regeneration.
